response.rationale: History of choroidal melanoma with new intraconal lesion and characteristic MRI signal strongly favor orbital metastasis from melanoma; R7 specifies the exact entity, while R1 lacks orbital localization and R5 lacks melanoma origin.

rejected.why: Less specific; does not name melanoma origin.
Scleral melanoma metastasis contradicted by normal anterior/posterior segment.
Lacks explicit orbital site, though otherwise plausible.
Cavernous hemangioma typically T2 hyperintense, not hypointense.
Schwannoma less likely given melanoma history and MRI pattern.
Same as R6; imaging pattern inconsistent.
